claim_limit: Construction-only metadata and file-bundling validation. Does not authenticate run authorship, prove event/sample co-origin against deliberate copying, test a live episode, locate effect time, establish causality/recovery, or complete MAP01.
decision_gate: PASS only if the valid directory reaches the existing classifier unchanged, and any source-map mismatch, wrong summary schema, malformed/missing metadata, or sample-count mismatch fails closed.
hypothesis: A co-located runtime bundle can reject a wrong v15 source manifest or incomplete scorer sample file before running the existing admission-bracket classifier.
resources: Local deterministic Python; no container, game, model, GUI, OS input, GPU, or formal allocation.
test: CPU-only synthetic runtime-shaped directory cases: valid bundle; changed and unexpected source entries; modified frozen policy; wrong summary schema; controller-visible summary; missing metadata; sample-count mismatch; and malformed scorer rows. Reuse the frozen expected source inventory from an existing current-main MAP01 v15 runtime.
